items.context: Aapke account ka number kya hai
Recharge kab kiya tha aapne
Kitna recharge kiya tha aapne
Kya aapke paas transaction ID hai
Kya aapne pehle bhi ye recharge kiya tha
Kya aapke phone me balance dikh raha hai
items.text: Nahi kuch bhi dikh nahi raha

items.context: Kya aapko plan activate hone ka message mila
Aapka network provider kaun sa hai
Kya aap prepaid user hain
Recharge SMS aapko mila tha
Transaction ke time koi error aaya tha
items.text: Nahi koi error report nahi hua

items.context: Paise account se kat gaye the
Kya aapne online ya USSD se recharge kiya
Aapka phone abhi switch on hai
Kya aapke pass bank statement hai
Payment mode kya tha aapka
Kya transaction fail hua tha
Recharge ke baad kitna data mila aapko
Kab aapne recharge kiya tha aur kitna amount hua tha
items.text: Kal raat ko roughly pachaas rupees ka recharge tha

items.context: Kya aapko transaction confirmation SMS ya email mila
items.text: Haan ek message aaya tha lekin recharge activate nahi hua

items.context: Aapka balance pehle kitna tha aur ab kitna dikh raha hai
items.text: Pehle 10 rupees the lekin ab zero balance dikh raha hai

items.context: Kya aapne kisi aur sim ya number par recharge try kiya hai
items.text: Nahi sirf isi number se recharge kiya hai

items.context: Recharge ke baad aapne mobile ko restart kiya ya nahi
items.text: Haan recharge ke baad mainne phone restart kiya tha

items.context: Kya aapke mobile me sufficient space tha recharge app ke liye
items.text: Haan phone me space theek tha recharge app chalne ke liye

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: telecom
Intent: recharge_not_credited - recharged but the plan or balance was not credited
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').

The voice agent has just asked the customer a question, and the customer replies.
Write exactly 24 different (agent_question, reply) pairs. agent_question is one short question
the agent asks during this call; reply is the customer's complete answer to it.
- "short": exactly 18 pairs whose reply is 1-4 words,
- "medium": exactly 6 pairs whose reply is 5-12 words.
At least 8 replies must be complete answers that could also be the start of a longer
one, such as 'haan ji', 'theek hai', 'kal tak', 'abhi nahi', or a bare number (an amount, a date, an OTP).
Vary the questions. Do not number them.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"agent_question": "...", "reply": "..."}, ...], "medium": [...]}
Every question and reply must be in Latin script.
